caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular section filled with a repeating pattern of floral and leaf motifs on a beige or tan background. The flowers are large and predominantly red with accents of yellow, white, and pink, featuring green leaves in various shapes and shades. Smaller blue, white, and red flowers, as well as blue and green leaves, are scattered throughout the design. The floral clusters are outlined in black, which helps define the individual petals and leaves. The layout is dense, with the motifs evenly distributed across the surface, and the overall composition is bounded by a plain, off-white border. There are visible signs of age and staining in the upper right corner of the border area.
title: Patchwork Bedspread
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
